turns.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?

response.answer:
**Get Smart** é a máquina mais completa, com touchscreen e apps. **Get Clássica** é a mais simples e mais barata.

| Item | Get Clássica | Get Smart |
|---|---|---|
| Conectividade | 3G, com plano de dados gratuito [S1]. A página de produtos também cita Wi-Fi [S5]. | 4G com plano de dados gratuito, Wi-Fi e Bluetooth [S3]. A página de produtos cita 3G, 4G e Wi-Fi [S5]. |
| Tela e controles | Botões físicos [S1] | Touchscreen [S3] |
| Pagamentos | Aproximação, QR Code e Pix [S5] | Chip, tarja magnética e aproximação (NFC) [S3]. QR Code e Pix também aparecem na página de produtos [S5]. |
| Comprovante | Bobina de material reciclado, com duas bobinas na caixa [S1][S5] | Reimpressão nas vias do estabelecimento e do cliente [S3]. A página de produtos destaca "Nota fiscal" [S5]. |
| Apps e gestão | Não encontrei menção a apps de automação. | Aceita apps de automação, como comanda eletrônica, instalados pela Getstore [S4][S6]. Tem modo quiosque e teste de hardware [S3]. |
| Mensalidade, se não atingir o faturamento mínimo | R$ 79,90 [S2][S5] | R$ 129,90 [S2][S5] |
| Faturamento para ganhar a máquina grátis | R$ 10 mil/mês [S2] | R$ 60 mil/mês [S2] |

A Get Smart é portátil e é indicada para bares e restaurantes [S4].

**Limitações:** não encontrei nas fontes o tamanho da tela, a bateria nem a lista completa de apps. Os valores podem mudar, então confirme no site da Getnet.

turns.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?

response.answer:
Yes, you need an account to receive your Pix sales. It doesn't have to be a traditional bank account, though. You can use either of these:

- **Your own bank account.**
- **Get Conta**, Getnet's free digital business account. You can use it to send and receive money and to sell via Pix.

**How it works:**
- You sign up for Pix in the Minha Conta portal or in the Getnet app.
- You enter a Pix key that is linked to the account where you want to receive the money.
- Your Pix sales are then settled in the account linked to that key.
- In the app, go to Services > Pix to see which account is enabled to receive Pix.

**Limits of this answer:**
- Pix availability depends on the payment institutions (PSPs) already integrated with Getnet. Ask the Central de Atendimento whether your bank is one of them.
- The sources I found don't give the exact settlement time for Pix. They also don't say whether any fees or conditions apply.

- You sign up for Pix in the Minha Conta portal or in the Getnet app.
- You enter a Pix key that is linked to the account where you want to receive the money.
- Your Pix sales are then settled in the account linked to that key.
- In the app, go to Services > Pix to see which account is enabled to receive Pix.

**Limits of this answer:**
- Pix availability depends on the payment institutions (PSPs) already integrated with Getnet. Ask the Central de Atendimento whether your bank is one of them.

- The advance fee is charged separately from your sales rates [S3].
- I couldn't find the percentage in the sources, so I won't estimate it.

- Plano de Recebimento Reduzido pays in-person credit sales in 2 business days [S4].
- Crediário pays in up to 2 business days, with a single fee and no advance cost [S8].

For the exact fee and the steps, check the Getnet app or call the Central de Relacionamento at 4002-4000. I can also look at your own receivables schedule if you'd like.

turns.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?

response.answer:
With the Crediário you can split a sale into up to 48 installments on a credit card [S1][S3].

- **Card issuer limits:** The maximum term and the interest rate depend on the customer's card issuer [S1]. The customer may therefore see fewer than 48 installments.
- **Payment to you:** You receive the full sale amount in one payment, within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, however many installments there are. The discount fee is deducted from that amount [S2].
- **Fees:** The fee is a single flat rate, and there is no anticipation cost [S1]. You can check your rate (MDR) in the Getnet Brasil app or the Customer Portal [S1].
- **Simulation:** Getnet shows a simulation of every installment and the charges before the sale [S1].
- **Activation:** Getnet has to approve the Crediário before you can use it [S2]. To turn it off, contact the Central de Atendimento [S2].

Don't confuse it with the Parcelado Lojista. That one has no interest for the customer and is limited to 12 installments. It also pays out differently: the first installment arrives at D+31 and the rest every 30 days [S2].

The sources don't give a minimum installment amount or other restrictions. The Central de Atendimento can confirm those.
